Name: Smaller Pet Bowls Suite
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/LzR0kF4j/description.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][Alt text = Description][/size][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Adds a new smaller pet bowl building, featuring recolors for other building/recolors. [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][i]Does not touch the vanilla pet bowl building. [/i][/size][/color]

[center][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/jPf7mqYX/main-features.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][Alt text = Main Features] [/size][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Adds a new building to Robin's shop menu that is just bowl part of the pet bowl. It does the same thing as the vanilla one, it's just more compact. [/size][/color]

[size=3][b][i]Config Option:[/i][/b][/size]
[size=3]Bowl Recolor: Vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25616]Seasonal Pet Bowl Retexture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34624]Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings[/url][/size]
[size=3]You are free to change it to whichever you prefer![/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/HfBR81P6/compatibility.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][Alt text = Compatibility] [/size][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Should be compatible with every other mod, including mods that add buildings. [/size][/color]

[center][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/LDVRCwmD/shout-outs.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][Alt text = Shout Outs] [/size][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]HUGE shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/EmuEngine]EmuEngine[/url] for making the C# component for this mod. [/size][/color]
